rationale: The ui.js emitter now lowers a captured theme-painted range, checkbox or radio (native_theme verdict native) onto RangeSlider / Checkbox in the chromium_refresh skin with the HTML state the native and baked C++ lanes already apply from the shared ua_form_control_state() parse, and records each node's captured snapped paint rect, through new or widened WidgetBridge setters (setUaSkin, setCheckboxKind, setCapturedPaintRect; setAccentColor and setRadioGroup reach Checkbox). This brings one emitter into line with the others; Chromium stays the only oracle and Skia/Dawn the renderer, so no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves. The same change reaches design-ir-contract and design-source-ingest: the ui.js lowering (design_codegen.cpp, design_js_capture_lowering.*) reads the captured IR node through the UaFormControlState parse, which moves unchanged from design_import_form_controls.hpp into the shared internal header design_ua_form_control_state.hpp so all three lanes use one parse; no IR field, schema or public header changes. The emitter conformance test, its registration and the import-design skill note gain the button and form-control cases that hold the lanes together. These families were covered by the emitter-conformance PR's event while this branch was stacked on it; that PR has merged, so this event now claims them for this branch's own change.
